entry.focal: Two near hanging lanterns (lights0:4/0:5) blown out at top-centre, then the even lantern necklace and the walk_north stair glow; the right 30% is the drum as an unlit dark slab.
entry.next_visible: Yes, weakly: the walk_north stair at centre and lit floor lanterns along the outer wall lead west. The camera cannot see its own target: the line from (96.6,61.6) to (83.6,65.6) passes 6.1 m from the drum centre (r 8), so the lift door is hidden behind the drum.

reveal.focal: A 4+ m beige outer wall lit by floor lanterns lights1:13/lights2:0 in the foreground; walk_north stair foot centre-right.
reveal.next_visible: Yes: the stair to walk_north is clearly framed, but it is dim. There is no teal window or steam glimpse.

concept.focal: The near hanging lanterns (top-centre glare) and the underside of the Spiral Stair helix overhead; the lift door is not visible; the lift bridge reads as two loose slabs over a black pit.
concept.next_visible: Walk_north stair at centre, with lanterns along the wall leading to it.

strip.focal: From frame 3 on, the slide-shaft or lava glow far to the SE (a large warm-white cylinder) dominates every frame. The lobby itself is an even ring of identical cubes.
strip.next_visible: Yes: the SE exit opens wide onto the vault, so the next space is obvious. The ring hall does not feel enclosed or low: no canopy, other levels are visible overhead.

fixes.detail: 32 lantern_hanging at an even ~1.7 m all round r 8.8. That is 1.4 m inboard of the walked arc (r~10.2) and only ~1 m above eye height, so they glare at the top of every frame and read as a uniform necklace. Use clusters of 3-5 at the lift door (bearing 235.5), the Spiral Stair door (55.5) and one on the SE face (~145, the only drum face visible from the SE exit), with 4-6 m dark gaps elsewhere. Set radius 8.3 and height [3.2,3.6].

In the graybox the lift_core is an unlit dark column / open well and never reads as the focal point. Give the lift door a bronze emissive panel (1.8x2.4 at bearing 235.5) and the Spiral Stair mouth a warm glow, and add a lit bronze call-panel or niche at bearing ~145 on the SE face. Neither door is visible from the SE exit: the visible arcs are 222-318 deg from the W portal and 90-192 deg from the SE portal.

Retarget the entry camera from (83.6,65.6) to the visible SE drum face, e.g. target (92.3,62.4,-64.6), so the hero is centred rather than occluded by itself. Or make 'entry' the lift arrival: pos (82.6,63.8,-65.4) looking SW toward (78,70,-65.5).

The edge_band rock scatter produced 1 rock (dressing0:0, on the north arc), so the whole walked south arc is a bare tall wall with lanterns only. Raise density to ~0.12 on the south arc, cluster 2-3 rocks around spring_basin and sign_se, and keep the middle of the walk clear.

The lift bridge renders as two separate 2 m slabs (anchored0:0 / 0:1) floating over a black well in the concept frame. Make it one continuous 5.8 m railed deck (rail 1.0 m) from the lift door (83.41,65.47) to the car (88.19,68.75).

top_change: Make the lift drum the lit focal point: an emissive bronze lift door plus a glowing stair mouth, with the hanging lanterns clustered at the doors instead of an even necklace overhead, and put in the low canopy so the ring feels compressed.
plausibility: The ring canopy (-63.5 at the outer wall) is not modelled: the outer wall reads 4+ m tall with open void above, other levels are visible through it, and the hanging lanterns float with nothing to hang from.
The drum's stair well is an open dark pit right beside the ring walk (strip frames 0-3, lower left) with no visible rail or kerb.
Lift bridge: two disconnected deck pieces over the well.
